description.narrative: CAFOD and Fair & Sustainable Consulting (F&S) have entered into an agreement to support CAFOD on integrating the Market Systems Development (MSD) approach in their development programs. The work is performed in four countries including Sierra Leone/Liberia, Zimbabwe, Kenya/Uganda and DR Congo. In DRC the CAFOD teams will take the lead with distance backstopping, data analysis and strategy advise by F&S with the support of a national consultant. The following will be done by the consultant: - Documentary inventory of the value chains with economic potential for the target group (smallholders, men, women and youth) according to the areas, agricultural practices and food habits of the communities and stakeholders. - Collect secondary data on the criteria defined by CAFOD and F&SC (This step will be sufficiently in-depth to differentiate the high potential value chains according to the criteria set by CAFOD and F&SC.) Two steps are planned, a first quick scan on a few (four to five) key criteria (economic, inclusion, climate). IES will start with 20, then 8 Value Chains. This will result in a maximum of eight value chains for a more in-depth scan on a number of criteria (to be defined by CAFOD and F&SC) to finally arrive at two value chains. - Organise workshop with key stakeholders to confirm the ranking and select the two most appropriate value chains. - Produce and submit to F&S Consulting and CAFOD for validation the final report of the value chain analyses considering the potential and opportunities for development of their markets for each specific area. - Presentation of the report in a validation workshop of two proposed value chains
